identity.name: Formula 1 x Kith

case.material: stainless steel (also released in black-PVD steel and Arnite plastic across the collection)

identity.one_liner: A May 2024 TAG Heuer x Kith collaboration spanning ten Formula 1 quartz models, sold out within weeks of release.

provenance_events.description: TAG Heuer and Kith release a ten-model Formula 1 quartz collaboration (announced May 1, 2024, general release May 6) across a combined production of roughly 5,750 watches plus 75 ten-piece box sets. The range sells out shortly after launch; within a month, resale prices for individual models climb to roughly $1,800-$2,500 against the $1,500 retail price.

narrative.story: TAG Heuer's Formula 1 line is its entry-level quartz sports watch, first introduced in 1986. In May 2024, TAG Heuer partnered with streetwear brand Kith on a ten-model capsule across steel, black-PVD steel, and Arnite plastic cases, each produced in runs of 250 to 1,350 pieces, plus a 75-unit ten-watch box set priced at $18,000. The collaboration drew heavy press coverage and sold out shortly after its Miami Grand Prix weekend debut.
narrative.collector_notes: The collaboration spans ten distinct reference numbers (WA121F.BA0023, WA121J.BT0012, WA121L.BT0014, WA126A-E.BT0005-9, WA121N/P.BA0023) in different case materials and production runs; confirm the exact reference and material before assuming interchangeable value — this card represents the steel WA121F model.
